text: You already have some protection: Timothy has $140,000 and Melanie has $110,000 in life insurance. Think of those policies like an umbrella you both keep at home — it gives some coverage when it rains, but the umbrella is smaller than the storm size you’re facing with two kids, ages 6 and 3, and two incomes of $150,000 and $120,000. That simple image can help you and your partner talk about whether you want a bigger umbrella so the family stays covered and feels safe.
